environment.description: ECS Fargate service deployed in isolated private subnet (10.50.4.0/22) within a VPC that has NO NAT Gateway and NO VPC endpoints for STS or any AWS service except ECR (pull-through cache for image pulls via com.amazonaws.us-east-1.ecr.dkr and ecr.api interface endpoints). Route table for the subnet contains only local route (10.50.0.0/16 -> local) with no default route entry. The task execution role has ecr:GetAuthorizationToken and ecr:BatchGetImage for image pull only. The task role itself has sts:AssumeRole but since there is no network path to the STS regional endpoint (no interface endpoint for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sts, no NAT, no proxy), all STS API calls from the container will timeout/fail with connection errors. Additionally, the VPC has DNS resolution enabled but no Route53 resolver outbound endpoint, so external DNS queries for sts.us-east-1.amazonaws.com resolve but TCP connections to the resolved IP are black-holed by the absent route.

config.vpc_config: isolated private subnet 10.50.4.0/22, NO NAT Gateway, NO internet gateway route
config.task_role_policy: sts:AssumeRole on Resource * (IAM policy exists but network unreachable)
config.security_group_egress: allow 443 to pl-63a5400a (com.amazonaws prefix list) only
config.dns_resolution: enabled (resolves but cannot connect to non-endpoint services)
